english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a knitted warm top, including one worn by athletes before or after exercise.
This is the all-purpose spoken Hong Kong Cantonese word for a sweater or pullover.
This is the all-purpose everyday Hong Kong term for the knitted upper-body garment.

examples.english: After exercising, even if you are sweaty, put your sweater back on before you leave.
examples.traditional: 做完運動出晒汗，都要着返件冷衫先好走。

examples.english: It's cold, so I put on a thick jersey.
examples.traditional: 天氣凍，我着咗件厚冷衫。
